title: Rest And Still Rise
style: soul ballad, slow emotional 62-68 bpm, warm felt piano, brushed kit entering at the chorus, deep rounded bass, soulful lead vocal with melismatic runs, close dry upfront vocal, minor key, restrained verse opening into a full-voiced chorus, no distortion. Warm female lead, sung melody with long held open vowels, slow tempo. The lead SPEAKS the lines tagged Spoken in a plain natural voice over the music, and SINGS the lines tagged Sung with long held notes. Only the short intro and the final outro are spoken; the full band keeps playing continuously under them, natural resolved ending, final chord rings out and fades.
negative_tags: rap, rapping, choir, reverb, echo, band dropout, acapella sections, talk-singing, monotone delivery

segments.lyrics:
[Intro (spoken): close dry voice, plain speech, no melody]
Running on empty.

[Vocalise (sung): wordless, full melodic voice, two very long held notes]
Ooh-oo-ooh, ooh-oo-ooh

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 1 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
The bills stack on the ta-able,
I smile like I am a-able,
Two in the morning, sti-ill,
I cannot climb this hi-ill,

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Product (sung): melodic, warm, clear diction on the name]
She handed me a bo-ook,
The Unhurried Year, look,

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Outro (spoken): calm close voice, plain speech, no melody]
The Unhurried Year by Dana Wells. Rest is not quitting. Get the book today.

[End]
